basic_info.description: Situated in the sought-after Sunset District, this fully updated 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom tunnel-entry home is move-in ready. The main level showcases beautiful original hardwood floors, and the home blends modern improvements with preserved period details that highlight its classic charm. The owner has thoughtfully updated the kitchen and bathrooms, combining contemporary convenience with timeless design. The kitchen features all-new stainless steel appliances and a wonderful skylight that fills the space with natural light. The very large backyard features low-maintenance astroturf an ideal space for kids to play, entertaining guests, or simply relaxing outdoors. The spacious garage easily accommodates two cars and includes a workbench, abundant storage space, and a convenient electric car charger.    With versatile living spaces and thoughtful upgrades throughout, this home offers flexibility for families, multi-generational living, or rental potential. Just a short walk to Noriega Street shops and the Sunset Boulevard transit corridor, this location offers both convenience and community.
